strings.meta.title: pdff — Hlanganisa, guquula goduso edita i-PDF, i-Word, i-Excel mahala
strings.meta.description: Ithuluzi lamahhala le-inthanethi lokuhlanganisa, ukuguquula, ukunciphisa, ukwehlukanisa nokuvikela i-PDF yakho, i-Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint kanye amafayili wemifanekiso. Awunelisi ukubhalisa, amafayili asulwa ngokuphangisa.
strings.meta.keywords: hlanganisa i-pdf, guquula i-pdf, i-pdf ukuya ku-word, word ukuya ku-pdf, jpg ukuya ku-pdf, pdf ukuya ku-jpg, ncinifica i-pdf, wehlukanisa i-pdf, excel ukuya ku-pdf, amathuluzi wamahhala e-pdf
strings.footer.text: Mahhala, awukho umsebenzi wokubhalisa. Amafayili akho asulwa mhlana kuphetha ukusebenza.
strings.home.title: Amadokhumenti akho woke, ethuluzini elilodwa.

strings.home.trust: Mahhala, akukho kubhalisa, akukho uphawu olungeziweyo.

strings.home.steps[0].text: Hudula amafayili akho noma uwakhethe ngocingo lwakho.

strings.workspace.dropAny: I-PDF, i-Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint, imifanekiso, EPUB, umbhalo…
strings.workspace.approximate: Kusuka ku-PDF, ukwakheka kuyabuye kwakhiwe kabusha: umphumela ungadinga ukuthintwa, ikakhulu kudokhumenti eskeniweyo.
strings.workspace.targetEmpty: Faka ifayili ukuze ubone amafomethi atholakalayo.

strings.language.title: Khetha ulimi
strings.language.unavailable: Ukuhumusha okuzenzakalelayo akukavulwa kuleseva: i-pdff iboniswa ngesiNgisi.
strings.language.failed: Ukuhumusha ku-{lang} kwehlulekile. Sicela uzame futhi kamuva.
strings.seo.why[0].title: 100% mahhala
strings.seo.why[0].text: Akukho okubhaliselweyo, akukho ikhadi lezikweletu, akukho uphawu olungeziweyo emadokhumentini akho.
strings.seo.why[1].title: Akukho ukubhalisa
strings.seo.why[1].text: Akukho akhawunti yokwakha: vula ikhasi, phosa amafayili akho, kuphelile.
strings.seo.why[2].title: Amafayili akho ahlala angawakho
strings.seo.why[2].text: Kusebenziwe, bese kusulwa ngokuphangisa. Asigcini amadokhumenti akho noma imininingwane yakho.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Yonke ifomethi
strings.seo.why[3].text: I-PDF, i-Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint, i-OpenDocument, imifanekiso, EPUB… kusuka kukhompyutha noma kumakhalekhukhwini.
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Yebo. Zonke izinsiza zimahhala, azinawo uphawu futhi akukho okufihliweyo emva kokubhalisa. Akukho khadi lezikweletu elicelwayo.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Cha. Awubhalisi, akukho ikheli le-imeyili: usebenzisa amathuluzi ngokuphangisa.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Cha. Amafayili akho asetshenziselwa kuphela umsebenzi owucebileyo, bese ayasuswa. Akukho owaqondayo futhi awakaze abelwe.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Yebo. I-pdff isebenza kusiphequluli sanoma yimuphi umakhalekhukhwini, ithebhulethi noma ikhompyutha (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), kungandile ukufakwa okungeziweyo.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: I-PDF, i-Word (DOCX, DOC), i-Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), i-PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), i-OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), i-RTF, imifanekiso (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML nokunye.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Ungaphandle amafayili afika ku-{files} ngesikhathi sinye, futhi idokhumenti ekhiqiziweyo ingaba namakhasi afika ku-{pages}.
strings.privacy.title: Ubumfihlo
strings.privacy.description: Indlela i-pdff ephatha ngayo amafayili akho: akukho akhawunti, akukho dokhumenti egciniweyo, akukho zikhangiso futhi akukho ukuthengiswa kwemininingwane.
strings.privacy.intro: I-pdff yakhelwe ukuthi amadokhumenti akho ahlale angawakho. Nanka amazwi acacileyo ngalokho okwenzekayo nxa uyisebenzisa.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Amafayili akho
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Athunyelwa ngokufihliweyo (HTTPS), aphathwa ngokuzenzakalelayo, bese asulwa mhlana kuphela umphumela. Amafayili amakhulu adlula endaweni yesikhashana ngaphansi kwegama elingahleliweyo futhi asulwa mhlana umsebenzi uphetha; ukuhlanzwa okuzenzakalelayo kususa konke okungase kusale kungakapheli amahora angama-24.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Akukho akhawunti, akukho mininingwane yomuntu
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: I-pdff ayiceli ukubhalisa, akukho ikheli le-imeyili futhi akukho khadi lezikweletu. Amadokhumenti akho awakaze afundwe, ahlaziywe, abelwe noma asetshenziselwe ukuqeqesha ubuchopho bokwenziwa.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Ukulinganiswa kwezivakashi
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Sibala izivakashi ngaphandle kokwaziwa nangaphandle kwamakhukhi (Vercel Web Analytics) ukuze sifunde ukuthi yimaphi amathuluzi awusizo. Akukho zikhangiso, akukho ukulandelela okuvela kwenye indawo.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Amakhukhi
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Ikhukhi elilodwa, elikhethekayo: likhumbula ulimi olukhethileyo.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Ukusingathwa
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Isayithi lisingathwa yiVercel kumaseva aseParis; ukuguqulwa kwe-Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint kuphathwa yiRender eFrankfurt. Laba abahlinzeki baphethe amafayili ngesikhathi sokuguqulwa kuphela.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Thintana nathi
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Umbuzo noma umbono? Sifinyelele kuleli khasi lephrojekthi:
strings.tools.fusionner.name: Hlanganisa
strings.tools.fusionner.tagline: Hlanganisa amafayili ambalwa (PDF, Word, imifanekiso…) abe yi-PDF eyodwa, ngendlela oyikhethileyo.
strings.tools.fusionner.seoTitle: Hlanganisa amafayili we-PDF ku-inthanethi mahhala (Word, imifanekiso, PDF)
strings.tools.fusionner.seoDescription: Hlanganisa i-PDF, i-Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint kanye nemifanekiso ibe yi-PDF eyodwa, ngendlela oyifunayo. Mahhala, akukho kubhalisa, akukho uphawu, amafayili asulwa ngokuphangisa.
strings.tools.fusionner.intro: Faka wonke amaphepha akho kufayili eyodwa: i-pdff ithatha ama-PDF kodwa futhi namadokhumenti e-Word, amashidi e-Excel, izethulo nezithombe, ikuhlanganise kube yi-PDF ehlanzekileyo enophawu lwekheli ngalinye.
strings.tools.fusionner.options.bookmarks.label: Faka uphawu lwekheli olulodwa ngefayili
strings.tools.convertir.name: Guquula
strings.tools.convertir.tagline: Guquula noma yiluphi udokhumenti noma isithombe kube ngenye ifomethi.
strings.tools.convertir.seoTitle: Guquula i-PDF iye ku-Word, Word iye ku-PDF, JPG iye ku-PDF — mahhala
strings.tools.convertir.seoDescription: Isiguquli samahhala: PDF ↔ Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG, EPUB namafomethi angaphezu kwama-40. Ku-inthanethi, akukho kubhalisa, izinga eliphezulu.
strings.tools.convertir.intro: Isiguquli esisodwa sayo yonke ifomethi: Word iye ku-PDF, PDF iye ku-Word, JPG iye ku-PDF, PDF iye ku-JPG, Excel iye ku-PDF, PowerPoint iye ku-PDF, PNG iye ku-JPG, EPUB iye ku-PDF… Phosa amafayili akho bese i-pdff inikeza kuphela amafomethi angenzeka.

strings.tools.diviser.name: Wehlukanisa
strings.tools.diviser.tagline: Wehlukanisa i-PDF ibe ngamafayili ambalwa: ngemikhawulo yamakhasi noma ikhasi ngelekhasi.
strings.tools.diviser.seoTitle: Wehlukanisa i-PDF ku-inthanethi mahhala — amakhasi ahlukileyo
strings.tools.diviser.seoDescription: Wehlukanisa i-PDF ibe ngamafayili ambalwa: ngemikhawulo yamakhasi, ikhasi ngelekhasi noma onke amakhasi angu-N. Mahhala, kuyashesha futhi akukho kubhalisa.
strings.tools.diviser.intro: Thumela ingxenye eyodwa kuphela yodokhumenti omkhulu: i-pdff isika i-PDF yakho ngemikhawulo oyikhethileyo bese ibuyisela izingcezu kungqimba lwe-ZIP.

strings.tools.extraire.tagline: Gcina noma susa amakhasi athile e-PDF.
strings.tools.extraire.seoTitle: Khipha noma sula amakhasi ku-PDF — mahhala
strings.tools.extraire.seoDescription: Gcina kuphela amakhasi owadingayo ku-PDF, noma susa lawo angeziweyo. Ku-inthanethi, mahhala, akukho kubhalisa, akukho uphawu.
strings.tools.extraire.intro: Ikhasi elingenalutho, isithasiselo esingenamsebenzi, ikhasi eliphindaphindiweyo? Thayipha amakhasi ozowagcina noma owasuse (ngokwesibonelo 1-3, 7, 10-end) bese uthola i-PDF ehlanzekileyo ngemizuzwana.

strings.tools.extraire.options.pages.label: Amakhasi

strings.tools.organiser.tagline: Tshintsha ukulandelana kwamakhasi, phindaphinda, guquula emuva.
strings.tools.organiser.seoTitle: Hlela kabusha amakhasi e-PDF ku-inthanethi — mahhala
strings.tools.organiser.seoDescription: Tshintsha ukulandelana kwamakhasi e-PDF, phindaphinda amanye noma guquula udokhumenti woke. Mahhala, ku-inthanethi, akukho kubhalisa.
strings.tools.organiser.intro: Amakhasi aseskeniwe ngokungalandelani? Thayipha ukulandelana okutsha (ngokwesibonelo 3, 1, 2, 4-end) noma guquula udokhumenti woke: i-pdff iyenzela okusele.

strings.tools.pivoter.seoDescription: Phendula onke amakhasi e-PDF noma amanye kuphela, ngo-90°, 180° noma 270°. Mahhala, kuyashesha, akukho kubhalisa.
strings.tools.pivoter.intro: Ukuseskela okuphendukileyo noma ikhasi elibanzi? Phendula udokhumenti woke noma amakhasi owakhethileyo kuphela, ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa yizinga.

strings.tools.numeroter.seoDescription: Faka izinombolo zamakhasi ku-PDF: khetha indawo, ifomethi "1 / 10", inombolo yokuqala kanye nobukhulu. Mahhala, akukho kubhalisa.
strings.tools.numeroter.intro: Kuhle kakhulu kwisicelo, ifayili yesicelo noma umbiko: khetha indawo, ifomethi nenombolo yokuqala, bese i-pdff ibeka izinombolo zamakhasi akho kuhle.

strings.tools.compresser.seoDescription: Nciphisa i-PDF ukuze uyithumele nge-imeyili noma uyifake kuwebhusayithi esemthethweni. Amazinga amathathu wokunciphisa, mahhala.
strings.tools.compresser.intro: Ingosi yenqaba ifayili lakho ngoba liyasindisa? Ncinifica i-PDF yakho ngesikhathi ugcina umbhalo ucacile: khetha okungenakulahleka, okunconyiweyo noma okuqinileyo kuye ngobukhulu obudingayo.

strings.tools.proteger.intro: Ngaphambi kokuthumela iphepha lemali yenyanga noma udokhumenti wezempilo, vala nge-password eqinileyo: ngaphandle kwakho, akukho owaziyo ukuvula.

strings.tools.deverrouiller.intro: Uyayazi i-password, kodwa ukuyithayipha isikhathi sonke kuyadina? Yisuse kanye kwaphela. I-pdff ayikaze idlule i-password ongayaziyo.
